description: This file declares the `CasimirController` class, which provides an interface for communicating with a Casimir RF controller over network or socket connections. It includes methods for connecting, sending commands, polling, and reading RF packets, along with private utility functions for communication with NFC tags.

classes.name: CasimirController
classes.description: A class providing methods to control and communicate with the Casimir RF hardware.

methods.name: ConnectToTcpPort
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the RF controller via a TCP port.

methods.name: ConnectToUnixSocket
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the RF controller via a UNIX socket.

methods.name: SendBroadcast
methods.description: Sends broadcast data with specific parameters.

methods.name: Poll
methods.description: Polls for NFC-A and ISO-DEP responses.

methods.name: SendApdu
methods.description: Sends an APDU command to a specific receiver ID.

methods.name: CasimirController (constructor)
methods.description: Private constructor initializing with a socket.

methods.name: SelectNfcA
methods.description: Selects NFC-A and returns sender ID.

methods.name: SelectT4AT
methods.description: Selects T4AT by choosing NFC-A listener.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes from the socket.

methods.name: ReadRfPacket
methods.description: Reads an RF packet with timeout.
